<div class="card-body">
'''Electro-Rangefinder''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">電子測距儀</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">２フォース消費して任意の「ＡＴ－ＡＴレーザー砲」に配備する。２つ先の位置の目標を射撃できるようになる。加えて、「目標、メイン・ジェネレーター」に使用する場合、合計値に１を加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Electro-Rangefinder-PSA-150138980.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">インペリアル・ウォーカーの火砲に連動した長距離立体照準装置。照準補正機能により、ＡＴ－ＡＴの指揮官は遠距離の目標を正確に砲撃することができる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Electronic rangefinder.

'''Card text:'''
Use 2 Force to deploy on any AT-AT Cannon. It may fire at targets two sites away. Also, when used with Target The Main Generator, add 1 to the total.

'''Lore:'''
A long-range stereoscopic sight linked to an Imperial walker's guns. The aiming correction lets an AT-AT commander fire accurately at distant targets.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Electro-Rangefinder]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
